--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :
    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =
    forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed ⋙ Bipointed.swap :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Num.Bitwise
@[simp] lemma lxor_eq_xor (p q : PosNum) : p.lxor q = p ^^^ q := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The embedding of `Preord` into `Cat`.
-/
@[simps]
def preordToCat : Preord.{u} ⥤ Cat where
  obj X := Cat.of X.1
  map f := f.monotone.functor

--src: Mathlib.Order.OrdContinuous
theorem le_iff (hf : LeftOrdContinuous f) (h : Injective f) {x y} : f x ≤ f y ↔ x ≤ y := by
  simp only [← sup_eq_right, ← hf.map_sup, h.eq_iff]

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.LinOrd
instance : BundledHom.ParentProjection @LinearOrder.toPartialOrder :=
  ⟨⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.FinPartOrd
theorem FinPartOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_partOrd :
    FinPartOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ FinPartOrd PartOrd =
      forget₂ FinPartOrd PartOrd ⋙ PartOrd.dual := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.UpperHalfPlane.Metric
@[simp]
theorem center_im (z r) : (center z r).im = z.im * Real.cosh r :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.NonemptyFinLinOrd
instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap
    · ext b
      apply hφ
    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Interval.Basic
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem bot_mul : ⊥ * t = ⊥ :=
  rfl

instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap

      apply hφ
    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by

        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.NonemptyFinLinOrd
instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap
    · ext b
      apply hφ
    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

  functor := dual

  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap

      apply hφ
    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :
    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =
    forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed ⋙ Bipointed.swap :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Num.Bitwise
@[simp] lemma lxor_eq_xor (p q : PosNum) : p.lxor q = p ^^^ q := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The embedding of `Preord` into `Cat`.
-/
@[simps]
def preordToCat : Preord.{u} ⥤ Cat where
  obj X := Cat.of X.1
  map f := f.monotone.functor

--src: Mathlib.Order.OrdContinuous
theorem le_iff (hf : LeftOrdContinuous f) (h : Injective f) {x y} : f x ≤ f y ↔ x ≤ y := by
  simp only [← sup_eq_right, ← hf.map_sup, h.eq_iff]

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.LinOrd
instance : BundledHom.ParentProjection @LinearOrder.toPartialOrder :=
  ⟨⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.FinPartOrd
theorem FinPartOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_partOrd :
    FinPartOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ FinPartOrd PartOrd =
      forget₂ FinPartOrd PartOrd ⋙ PartOrd.dual := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.UpperHalfPlane.Metric
@[simp]
theorem center_im (z r) : (center z r).im = z.im * Real.cosh r :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.NonemptyFinLinOrd
instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap
    · ext b
      apply hφ
    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Interval.Basic
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem bot_mul : ⊥ * t = ⊥ :=
  rfl

instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap

    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.NonemptyFinLinOrd
instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap

      apply hφ
    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by

      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2

instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    swap

    · intro a b
      contrapose
      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne this
        rintro rfl
        exfalso
        simp at h
      have H : f (φ b) ≤ f (φ a) := f.monotone (le_of_lt h)
      simpa only [hφ] using H⟩

  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩

instance : SplitEpiCategory NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u} :=
  ⟨fun {X Y} f hf => by
    have H : ∀ y : Y, Nonempty (f ⁻¹' {y}) := by
      rw [epi_iff_surjective] at hf
      intro y
      exact Nonempty.intro ⟨(hf y).choose, (hf y).choose_spec⟩
    let φ : Y → X := fun y => (H y).some.1
    have hφ : ∀ y : Y, f (φ y) = y := fun y => (H y).some.2
    refine IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨⟨φ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩

      intro h
      simp only [not_le] at h ⊢
      suffices b ≤ a by

        exfalso
        simp at h

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.RelCat
instance graphFunctor_essSurj : graphFunctor.EssSurj :=

theorem UnivLE_iff_essSurj :

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :
    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =
    forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed ⋙ Bipointed.swap :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
theorem surjective_tail : Surjective (@tail α)
  | [] => ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | a :: l => ⟨a :: a :: l, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.ULift
/-- One half of the equivalence between `C` and `AsSmall C`. -/
@[simps]
def AsSmall.down : AsSmall C ⥤ C where
  obj X := ULift.down X
  map f := f.down

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.RelCat
instance graphFunctor_essSurj : graphFunctor.EssSurj :=
    graphFunctor.essSurj_of_surj Function.surjective_id

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.UnivLE
theorem UnivLE_iff_essSurj :
    UnivLE.{max u v, v} ↔ (uliftFunctor.{u, v} : Type v ⥤ Type max u v).EssSurj :=
  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun w => UnivLE.ofEssSurj w⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :
    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =
    forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed ⋙ Bipointed.swap :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
theorem surjective_tail : Surjective (@tail α)
  | [] => ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | a :: l => ⟨a :: a :: l, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.ULift
/-- One half of the equivalence between `C` and `AsSmall C`. -/
@[simps]
def AsSmall.down : AsSmall C ⥤ C where
  obj X := ULift.down X
  map f := f.down

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.Quasicategory.Nerve
/-- By virtue of satisfying the `StrictSegal` condition, the nerve of a
category is a `Quasicategory`. -/
instance quasicategory {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] :
  Quasicategory (nerve C) := inferInstance

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where

  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/

def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

the 2-truncated nerve. -/

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/

def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

the 2-truncated nerve. -/

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

@[simp]

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/

  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

the 2-truncated nerve. -/

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

  functor := dual

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/

  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

the 2-truncated nerve. -/

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

lemma pred_self_lt (a : ℤ) : pred a < a := by unfold pred; omega

--src: Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
lemma natCast_le_natCast (han : a ≤ n) (hbn : b ≤ n) : (a : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff] at han hbn
  simp [le_iff_val_le_val, -val_fin_le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, han, hbn]

@[simp] lemma divInt_nonneg {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ a /. b := by

  · simp
    rfl
  rwa [divInt_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hb]

@[norm_cast]
theorem lt_to_nat {m n : Num} : (m : ℕ) < n ↔ m < n :=
  show (m : ℕ) < n ↔ cmp m n = Ordering.lt from
    match cmp m n, cmp_to_nat m n with
    | Ordering.lt, h => by simp only at h; simp [h]
    | Ordering.eq, h => by simp only at h; simp [h, lt_irrefl]
    | Ordering.gt, h => by simp [not_lt_of_gt h]

lemma pred_self_lt (a : ℤ) : pred a < a := by unfold pred; omega

--src: Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
lemma natCast_le_natCast (han : a ≤ n) (hbn : b ≤ n) : (a : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff] at han hbn
  simp [le_iff_val_le_val, -val_fin_le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, han, hbn]

@[simp] lemma divInt_nonneg {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ a /. b := by

  · simp
    rfl
  rwa [divInt_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hb]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Num.Lemmas
@[norm_cast]
theorem lt_to_nat {m n : Num} : (m : ℕ) < n ↔ m < n :=
  show (m : ℕ) < n ↔ cmp m n = Ordering.lt from
    match cmp m n, cmp_to_nat m n with
    | Ordering.lt, h => by simp only at h; simp [h]
    | Ordering.eq, h => by simp only at h; simp [h, lt_irrefl]
    | Ordering.gt, h => by simp [not_lt_of_gt h]

lemma pred_self_lt (a : ℤ) : pred a < a := by unfold pred; omega

--src: Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
lemma natCast_le_natCast (han : a ≤ n) (hbn : b ≤ n) : (a : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff] at han hbn
  simp [le_iff_val_le_val, -val_fin_le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, han, hbn]

@[simp] lemma divInt_nonneg {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ a /. b := by

  · simp
    rfl
  rwa [divInt_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hb]

@[norm_cast]
theorem lt_to_nat {m n : Num} : (m : ℕ) < n ↔ m < n :=
  show (m : ℕ) < n ↔ cmp m n = Ordering.lt from
    match cmp m n, cmp_to_nat m n with
    | Ordering.lt, h => by simp only at h; simp [h]
    | Ordering.eq, h => by simp only at h; simp [h, lt_irrefl]
    | Ordering.gt, h => by simp [not_lt_of_gt h]

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :

  rfl

/-- One half of the equivalence between `C` and `AsSmall C`. -/

  map f := f.down

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :

  rfl

lemma pred_self_lt (a : ℤ) : pred a < a := by unfold pred; omega

--src: Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
lemma natCast_le_natCast (han : a ≤ n) (hbn : b ≤ n) : (a : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff] at han hbn
  simp [le_iff_val_le_val, -val_fin_le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, han, hbn]

@[simp] lemma divInt_nonneg {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ a /. b := by
  obtain rfl | hb := hb.eq_or_lt
  · simp
    rfl
  rwa [divInt_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hb]

@[norm_cast]
theorem lt_to_nat {m n : Num} : (m : ℕ) < n ↔ m < n :=
  show (m : ℕ) < n ↔ cmp m n = Ordering.lt from
    match cmp m n, cmp_to_nat m n with

    | Ordering.eq, h => by simp only at h; simp [h, lt_irrefl]
    | Ordering.gt, h => by simp [not_lt_of_gt h]

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

the 2-truncated nerve. -/

  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Control.Traversable.Basic
/-- A traversable functor is lawful if its `traverse` satisfies a
number of additional properties.  It must send `pure : α → Id α` to `pure`,
send the composition of applicative functors to the composition of the
`traverse` of each, send each function `f` to `fun x ↦ f <$> x`, and
satisfy a naturality condition with respect to applicative
transformations. -/
class LawfulTraversable (t : Type u → Type u) [Traversable t] extends LawfulFunctor t :
    Prop where
  /-- `traverse` plays well with `pure` of the identity monad -/
  id_traverse : ∀ {α} (x : t α), traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = x
  /-- `traverse` plays well with composition of applicative functors. -/
  comp_traverse :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G] {α β γ}
      (f : β → F γ) (g : α → G β) (x : t α),
      traverse (Functor.Comp.mk ∘ map f ∘ g) x = Comp.mk (map (traverse f) (traverse g x))
  /-- An axiom for `traverse` involving `pure : β → Id β`. -/
  traverse_eq_map_id : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β) (x : t α),
    traverse ((pure : β → Id β) ∘ f) x = id.mk (f <$> x)
  /-- The naturality axiom explaining how lawful traversable functors should play with
  lawful applicative functors. -/
  naturality :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G]
      (η : ApplicativeTransformation F G) {α β} (f : α → F β) (x : t α),
      η (traverse f x) = traverse (@η _ ∘ f) x

protected theorem id_traverse {σ α} (x : σ ⊕ α) :
    Sum.traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = x := by cases x <;> rfl

--src: Mathlib.Control.Traversable.Basic
/-- A traversable functor is lawful if its `traverse` satisfies a
number of additional properties.  It must send `pure : α → Id α` to `pure`,
send the composition of applicative functors to the composition of the
`traverse` of each, send each function `f` to `fun x ↦ f <$> x`, and
satisfy a naturality condition with respect to applicative
transformations. -/
class LawfulTraversable (t : Type u → Type u) [Traversable t] extends LawfulFunctor t :
    Prop where
  /-- `traverse` plays well with `pure` of the identity monad -/
  id_traverse : ∀ {α} (x : t α), traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = x
  /-- `traverse` plays well with composition of applicative functors. -/
  comp_traverse :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G] {α β γ}
      (f : β → F γ) (g : α → G β) (x : t α),
      traverse (Functor.Comp.mk ∘ map f ∘ g) x = Comp.mk (map (traverse f) (traverse g x))
  /-- An axiom for `traverse` involving `pure : β → Id β`. -/
  traverse_eq_map_id : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β) (x : t α),
    traverse ((pure : β → Id β) ∘ f) x = id.mk (f <$> x)
  /-- The naturality axiom explaining how lawful traversable functors should play with
  lawful applicative functors. -/
  naturality :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G]
      (η : ApplicativeTransformation F G) {α β} (f : α → F β) (x : t α),
      η (traverse f x) = traverse (@η _ ∘ f) x

--src: Mathlib.Control.Traversable.Instances
protected theorem id_traverse {σ α} (x : σ ⊕ α) :
    Sum.traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = x := by cases x <;> rfl

--src: Mathlib.Control.Traversable.Basic
/-- A traversable functor is lawful if its `traverse` satisfies a
number of additional properties.  It must send `pure : α → Id α` to `pure`,
send the composition of applicative functors to the composition of the
`traverse` of each, send each function `f` to `fun x ↦ f <$> x`, and
satisfy a naturality condition with respect to applicative
transformations. -/
class LawfulTraversable (t : Type u → Type u) [Traversable t] extends LawfulFunctor t :
    Prop where
  /-- `traverse` plays well with `pure` of the identity monad -/
  id_traverse : ∀ {α} (x : t α), traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = x
  /-- `traverse` plays well with composition of applicative functors. -/
  comp_traverse :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G] {α β γ}
      (f : β → F γ) (g : α → G β) (x : t α),
      traverse (Functor.Comp.mk ∘ map f ∘ g) x = Comp.mk (map (traverse f) (traverse g x))
  /-- An axiom for `traverse` involving `pure : β → Id β`. -/
  traverse_eq_map_id : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β) (x : t α),
    traverse ((pure : β → Id β) ∘ f) x = id.mk (f <$> x)
  /-- The naturality axiom explaining how lawful traversable functors should play with
  lawful applicative functors. -/
  naturality :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G]
      (η : ApplicativeTransformation F G) {α β} (f : α → F β) (x : t α),
      η (traverse f x) = traverse (@η _ ∘ f) x

--src: Mathlib.Control.Traversable.Basic
/-- A traversable functor is lawful if its `traverse` satisfies a
number of additional properties.  It must send `pure : α → Id α` to `pure`,
send the composition of applicative functors to the composition of the
`traverse` of each, send each function `f` to `fun x ↦ f <$> x`, and
satisfy a naturality condition with respect to applicative
transformations. -/
class LawfulTraversable (t : Type u → Type u) [Traversable t] extends LawfulFunctor t :
    Prop where
  /-- `traverse` plays well with `pure` of the identity monad -/
  id_traverse : ∀ {α} (x : t α), traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = x
  /-- `traverse` plays well with composition of applicative functors. -/
  comp_traverse :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G] {α β γ}
      (f : β → F γ) (g : α → G β) (x : t α),
      traverse (Functor.Comp.mk ∘ map f ∘ g) x = Comp.mk (map (traverse f) (traverse g x))
  /-- An axiom for `traverse` involving `pure : β → Id β`. -/
  traverse_eq_map_id : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β) (x : t α),
    traverse ((pure : β → Id β) ∘ f) x = id.mk (f <$> x)
  /-- The naturality axiom explaining how lawful traversable functors should play with
  lawful applicative functors. -/
  naturality :
    ∀ {F G} [Applicative F] [Applicative G] [LawfulApplicative F] [LawfulApplicative G]
      (η : ApplicativeTransformation F G) {α β} (f : α → F β) (x : t α),
      η (traverse f x) = traverse (@η _ ∘ f) x

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun w => UnivLE.ofEssSurj w⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.RelCat
instance graphFunctor_essSurj : graphFunctor.EssSurj :=
    graphFunctor.essSurj_of_surj Function.surjective_id

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.UnivLE
theorem UnivLE_iff_essSurj :
    UnivLE.{max u v, v} ↔ (uliftFunctor.{u, v} : Type v ⥤ Type max u v).EssSurj :=
  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun w => UnivLE.ofEssSurj w⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :
    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =
    forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed ⋙ Bipointed.swap :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
theorem surjective_tail : Surjective (@tail α)
  | [] => ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | a :: l => ⟨a :: a :: l, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.ULift
/-- One half of the equivalence between `C` and `AsSmall C`. -/
@[simps]
def AsSmall.down : AsSmall C ⥤ C where
  obj X := ULift.down X
  map f := f.down

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.Quasicategory.Nerve
/-- By virtue of satisfying the `StrictSegal` condition, the nerve of a
category is a `Quasicategory`. -/
instance quasicategory {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] :
  Quasicategory (nerve C) := inferInstance

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun w => UnivLE.ofEssSurj w⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.Preord
/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Arrow
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (f : Arrow T) : Arrow.mk f.hom = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Types
/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.RelCat
instance graphFunctor_essSurj : graphFunctor.EssSurj :=
    graphFunctor.essSurj_of_surj Function.surjective_id

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.UnivLE
theorem UnivLE_iff_essSurj :
    UnivLE.{max u v, v} ↔ (uliftFunctor.{u, v} : Type v ⥤ Type max u v).EssSurj :=
  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun w => UnivLE.ofEssSurj w⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Category.BddOrd
theorem bddOrd_dual_comp_forget_to_bipointed :
    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =
    forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed ⋙ Bipointed.swap :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
theorem surjective_tail : Surjective (@tail α)
  | [] => ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | a :: l => ⟨a :: a :: l, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.ULift
/-- One half of the equivalence between `C` and `AsSmall C`. -/
@[simps]
def AsSmall.down : AsSmall C ⥤ C where
  obj X := ULift.down X
  map f := f.down

/-- By virtue of satisfying the `StrictSegal` condition, the nerve of a
category is a `Quasicategory`. -/
instance quasicategory {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] :
  Quasicategory (nerve C) := inferInstance

lemma natCast_le_natCast (han : a ≤ n) (hbn : b ≤ n) : (a : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff] at han hbn
  simp [le_iff_val_le_val, -val_fin_le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, han, hbn]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Cast.NeZero

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Ring.Unbundled.Rat
@[simp] lemma divInt_nonneg {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ a /. b := by
  obtain rfl | hb := hb.eq_or_lt
  · simp
    rfl
  rwa [divInt_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hb]

theorem lt_to_nat {m n : Num} : (m : ℕ) < n ↔ m < n :=
  show (m : ℕ) < n ↔ cmp m n = Ordering.lt from
    match cmp m n, cmp_to_nat m n with
    | Ordering.lt, h => by simp only at h; simp [h]
    | Ordering.eq, h => by simp only at h; simp [h, lt_irrefl]
    | Ordering.gt, h => by simp [not_lt_of_gt h]

/-- The equivalence between `Preord` and itself induced by `OrderDual` both ways. -/
@[simps functor inverse]
def dualEquiv : Preord ≌ Preord where
  functor := dual
  inverse := dual
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents fun X => Iso.mk <| OrderIso.dualDual X

/-- The yoneda functor that sends a type to a sheaf over the category of types. -/
@[simps]
def yoneda' : Type u ⥤ Sheaf typesGrothendieckTopology (Type u) where
  obj α := ⟨yoneda.obj α, Presheaf.isSheaf_yoneda'⟩
  map f := ⟨yoneda.map f⟩

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.HomotopyCat
/-- An equivalence between the type of objects underlying a category and the type of 0-simplices in
the 2-truncated nerve. -/
@[simps]
def OneTruncation₂.nerveEquiv :
    OneTruncation₂ ((SSet.truncation 2).obj (nerve C)) ≃ C where
  toFun X := X.obj' 0
  invFun X := .mk₀ X
  left_inv _ := ComposableArrows.ext₀ rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun w => UnivLE.ofEssSurj w⟩

    BddOrd.dual ⋙ forget₂ BddOrd Bipointed =

  rfl

/-- One half of the equivalence between `C` and `AsSmall C`. -/

def AsSmall.down : AsSmall C ⥤ C where
  obj X := ULift.down X
  map f := f.down

instance quasicategory {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] :
  Quasicategory (nerve C) := inferInstance

  rw [coe_int_add_eq_ite]
  split
  · rw [Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> omega
  · rw [Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod, Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> omega
-- Write `a + b` as `if (a + b : ℕ) < n then (a + b : ℤ) else (a + b : ℤ) - n` and
-- similarly `a - b` as `if (b : ℕ) ≤ a then (a - b : ℤ) else (a - b : ℤ) + n`.

lemma lt_sub_iff {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n} : a < a - b ↔ a < b := by
  cases' n with n
  · exact a.elim0
  constructor
  · contrapose!
    intro h
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Fin.not_lt.mp h)
    simpa only [Fin.not_lt, le_iff_val_le_val, sub_def, hl, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_mod_left,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.sub_add_cancel b.is_lt.le] using
        (le_trans (mod_le _ _) (le_add_left _ _))
  · intro h
    rw [lt_iff_val_lt_val, sub_def]
    simp only
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt b.is_lt
    have : n + 1 - b = k + 1 := by
      simp_rw [hk, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      -- simp_rw because, otherwise, rw tries to rewrite inside `b : Fin (n + 1)`
    rw [this, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hk.ge.trans_lt' ?_), Nat.lt_add_left_iff_pos] <;>
    omega

  simp [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_add, ← hk, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.is_lt]

@[simp] theorem finRotate_succ_apply (i : Fin (n + 1)) : finRotate (n + 1) i = i + 1 := by
  cases n
  · exact @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ _ _
  obtain rfl | h := Fin.eq_or_lt_of_le i.le_last
  · simp [finRotate_last]
  · cases i
    simp only [Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_mk] at h
    simp [finRotate_of_lt h, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.add_def, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ h)]
-- Porting note: was a @[simp]

@[simp]
theorem cons_vec_bit0_eq_alt0 (x : α) (u : Fin n → α) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    vecCons x u (i + i) = vecAlt0 rfl (vecAppend rfl (vecCons x u) (vecCons x u)) i := by
  rw [vecAlt0_vecAppend]; rfl
